About LoadShare

LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.

What sets us apart:

  • Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.
  • Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
  • Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
  • Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day.
  • Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
  • Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

  • Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
  • Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
  • Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco

The Role: Where Growth Meets Data Science

We're hiring a Data Scientist for the Rider Growth charter of LoadShare Product Org. This role goes beyond preparing data, conducting analysis and building dashboards. Your job starts where that ends: figuring out why a metric moved, and turning that into experiments and models that move it.

Your will look at the entire lifecycle of riders - acquisition, activation, retention, revenue and referral. You will own the why behind every growth metric and convert it into experiments and models that move the needle.

What You'll Work On

  • Causal analysis & RCA: Establish causation, not correlation, for why acquisition/activation/retention metrics move. Use controlled experiments, diff-in-diff, and quasi-experimental methods to move the team from "what happened" to "why, and what to do next."
  • Dynamic offers & incentives (ML): Build models for personalized/dynamic offers to address new rider hiring, engagement and reactivation at the right place and right time, balancing uplift in DAU and CAC.
  • Experimentation muscle: Design, run, and read rigorous A/B tests; own lift measurement; build the experimentation discipline so launches stop being "assume and ship."
  • Segmentation & cohorting: Rider and funnel segmentation, retention/cohort curves, and driver/decision-tree analysis to find the patterns that explain behaviour.
  • Forecasting & churn (retention side): Predict supply needs, churn risk, and recovery to inform retention and re-engagement strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years in Data Science/ML
  • Strong first principles — the core bar.
  • Python and practical ML: segmentation, decision trees, regression, and basic causal-inference methods.
  • Real grounding in experimentation and statistics — A/B testing, controlled experiments, reading lift honestly.
  • AI-native: uses Claude/LLM tooling to accelerate analysis
  • Strong communication, comfort being embedded with a PM and business teams, and a bias for action.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Growth, activation, or retention analytics or ML modelling experience.
  • Experience with dynamic pricing/incentives, geospatial data, or experimentation platforms.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience migrating Teams associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS 102) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises .
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Job Title: AI Model Quality Engineer Healthcare (Wellness & Digital Health)

Location: Bangalore

Experience

6 - 12+ years overall experience

3+ years in ML / AI model testing, validation, or governance

Role Overview

We are seeking an AI Model Quality Engineer to ensure trustworthiness, safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance of AI/ML models used in our platform. This role sits at the intersection of Quality Engineering, Data Science, Responsible AI, and Healthcare Compliance. You will serve as the independent validation authority within the Model Development Life Cycle (MDLC). Functioning as a strategic partner to but distinct from the Model Development team, you will ensure strict separation of concerns by owning the objective validation gates between "ML Model Testing" and "Clinical Handoff". You will be responsible for certifying that models meet all defined acceptance criteria before they are exposed to clinical evaluators or production traffic.

Key Responsibilities

1. Model Quality, Validation, & "Shift Left" Strategy

  • Requirements Definition: Partner with Clinical and Product teams during the Requirement Gathering phase to translate clinical goals into quantifiable technical acceptance criteria (e.g., defining specific thresholds for False Negatives, bias limits, or hallucination rates).
  • Golden Set Management: Create, maintain, and secure "Golden Datasets" and "Adversarial Test Sets" that are isolated from the training process, ensuring true out-of-sample validation.
  • Test Execution: Design and execute test strategies for AI/ML models (predictive, classification, recommendation, and GenAI/LLM-based systems).
  • Comprehensive Validation: Validate model behavior across accuracy, bias, robustness, stability, and safety using independent test pipelines.

2. Engineering & Clinical Handoffs

  • API Contract Validation: Validate model artifacts (containers, APIs) during the Non-production Model Deploy phase to ensure latency, throughput, and error handling meet Engineering Service Level Agreements (SLAs) before handoff.
  • Clinical Pre-Screening: Execute automated "Red Teaming" and safety checks (e.g., PII leakage, hallucination triggers) to sanitize models before they enter the Clinical Testing phase, maximizing the efficiency of Clinical SME time.
  • Release Gating: Own the final "Go/No-Go" decision for model promotion based on pre-defined quality gates.

3. Drift Detection, Monitoring & Feedback Loops

  • Automated Feedback Loops: Design and implement automated pipelines that trigger "Retraining Feedback Loops" when post-deployment monitoring detects drift or performance degradation.
  • Drift Mechanisms: Design and test data drift, concept drift, and prediction drift detection mechanisms.
  • Data Sanity Checks: Implement upstream validation to catch data quality issues (missing values, schema changes) before model training begins.
  • Alerting: Define thresholds, alerts, and runbooks for drift remediation and rollback strategies.

4. Explainability & Transparency

  • Validate model explainability using tools such as SHAP, LIME, Integrated Gradients, or equivalent.
  • Ensure explanations are clinically meaningful, auditable, and regulator-ready.
  • Partner with Data Science teams to define explainability acceptance criteria.

5. Hallucination & GenAI Safety (if LLMs are used)

  • Design test scenarios to detect hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and medical misinformation.
  • Validate grounding mechanisms (RAG, citations, confidence scoring).
  • Ensure models do not generate diagnostic or treatment advice beyond approved scope.

6. Healthcare Compliance & Responsible AI

  • Ensure AI systems align with HIPAA (PHI protection), FDA SaMD principles, and Responsible AI guidelines.
  • Participate in model risk reviews, audits, and governance forums.
  • Maintain documentation for model cards, data sheets, and audit artifacts.

Required Qualifications

Core Skills

  • Strong background in Quality Engineering / Validation / Test Automation.
  • Hands-on experience testing ML models and/or LLM-based systems.
  • Solid understanding of model lifecycle (training validation deployment monitoring); bias, fairness, drift, overfitting, and calibration.
  • Experience with Python, notebooks, and ML testing frameworks.

AI / ML Knowledge

  • Familiarity with Supervised & unsupervised ML models
  • Model explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME, etc.)
  • Evaluation metrics for ML and GenAI systems
  • ML testing frameworks
  • Experience with model monitoring tools or custom pipelines

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience testing GenAI / LLM systems (RAG, prompt evaluation, hallucination detection).
  • Exposure to FHIR, EHR integrations, or healthcare data standards.
  • Familiarity with Model Risk Management (MRM) or AI governance frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP).
  • Certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Quality Engineering.

title: Senior UCIe Verification Engineer
jobDescription:
Introduction

We are looking for a Senior UCIe Verification Engineer with strong experience in SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification of high-speed interconnects and SoC subsystems. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in verifying UCIe (Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express) IP and should have contributed to at least 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs. The role involves developing reusable verification environments, protocol compliance verification, subsystem/SoC integration, and driving verification closure.


About Edgecortix

At Edgecortix we are a deep-tech startup revolutionizing edge computing with artificial intelligence and novel high efficiency silicon on chip design. Originating from multiple years of research, our unique AI hardware & software co-design principle and the Dynamic Neural Accelerator AI processor IP are geared towards positively disrupting the rapidly growing artificial intelligence edge hardware space and bring the power of AI and machine learning to all kinds of devices. Our operations are headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with offices in Singapore, Virginia, California in the US. In addition, we are starting a new Design Center in India, located in Hyderabad.

The Team

As an engineering driven company we are working to define and solve the hardest problems in AI including computer vision, speech, and natural language, geared towards real-time capabilities on small to medium form factor devices. We originated out of multiple years of research, as such at our core we value learning, intellectual curiosity, and self-starters. We have the ambitious goal of enabling cloud-level performance with significantly better energy-efficiency for AI inference at the edge.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive verification plans for UCIe IP, subsystems, and SoC integration.
  • Build reusable SystemVerilog/UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Develop constrained-random and directed test scenarios to verify UCIe functionality and protocol compliance.
  • Verify UCIe protocol features, including:
    Link initialization and training
    Sideband communication
    Adapter layer
    Protocol layer
    Data transfer and flow control
    Link power management
    Error detection and recovery
    Reset and initialization sequences
  • Verify interoperability between UCIe and upper-layer protocols such as PCIe, CXL, or streaming interfaces.
  • Develop UVM agents, scoreboards, monitors, protocol checkers, and functional coverage models.
  • Write and debug SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) for protocol compliance and interface checks.
  • Perform coverage analysis and drive functional and code coverage closure.
  • Debug RTL, protocol, and testbench issues using simulation and waveform analysis.
  • Support gate-level simulations, regression execution, and silicon bring-up activities.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, DFT, firmware, physical design, and validation teams throughout the product development cycle.



Desired Qualifications:

  • 6-12 years of experience in functional verification using SystemVerilog and UVM.
  • Strong experience in developing complete UVM verification environments from scratch.
  • Good understanding of UCIe architecture and protocol.
  • Experience verifying high-speed serial interfaces or chiplet interconnects.
  • Strong understanding of:
    AXI4
    High-speed protocol verification
    Clock domain crossings (CDC)
    Reset domain crossings (RDC)
    Protocol compliance verification
  • Experience with constrained-random, assertion-based, and coverage-driven verification methodologies.
  • Strong experience writing SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA).
  • Experience with gate-level simulation and timing-aware verification.
  • Excellent RTL and protocol debugging skills.
  • Experience in verifying die-to-die interfaces or chiplet-based architectures.
  • Experience with subsystem and SoC-level verification.
  • Experience with emulator-based verification platforms.
  • Exposure to Formal Verification techniques.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • SoC Experience
    Hands-on experience in 1-2 successful SoC tape-outs.
    Experience integrating UCIe subsystems into complex SoCs.
    Exposure to boot flows, clock/reset architecture, power management, and chiplet integration.
    Experience collaborating with firmware and post-silicon validation teams during bring-up and debug.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

You are the offshore specialist leader for tenant to tenant endpoint migration readiness and escalation support. You guide Scale squads and the Factory through device migration sequencing, Intune re enrolment impacts, Autopilot/join state considerations and remediation patterns. This role is critical to avoiding mass disruption: endpoint readiness issues can block user productivity at wave cutovers, so your job is to standardise solutions, reduce repeat failures and provide rapid escalation leadership during cutover windows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide endpoint readiness guidance and risk assessments for migration waves.
  • Act as escalation authority for complex device migration failures and root cause analysis.
  • Define and maintain runbooks for common remediation scenarios (enrolment failures, compliance issues, profile/application targeting problems).
  • Coordinate dependencies with Identity and Security teams (device trust and access controls).
  • Support cutover events with rapid triage and stabilisation leadership.
  • Maintain known issues and fixes catalogue; reduce recurring defects through standard patterns.
  • Provide validation criteria and evidence standards for endpoint readiness and post migration acceptance.
  • Support the Factory discipline leads by improving troubleshooting playbooks and telemetry standards.
  • Provide reporting inputs on failure categories, remediation throughput and readiness health metrics.
  • Align to one region and adjust working patterns to support regional cutovers.

Who You Are

Must Have

  • Delivered tenant to tenant endpoint migration work in production (Intune/Windows specialism mandatory).
  • Deep Intune operational expertise and troubleshooting competence.
  • Practical understanding of device join state and provisioning concepts relevant to tenant transitions.
  • Proven ability to create runbooks, validation steps and known fix playbooks for repeatable execution.
  • Willingness to align working hours to regional cutovers (early/late calls) and support extended hours when required.
  • Strong documentation discipline and evidence first practices.
  • Ability to coach engineers and improve delivery maturity at pace.

Good to Have

  • Experience with workstation/profile migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) and hands on understanding of real world constraints.
  • Microsoft certification alignment relevant to endpoint management (or equivalent experience).
  • PowerShell scripting for diagnostics, readiness reporting and bulk remediation.
  • Experience with large, globally distributed device estates and remote workforce constraints.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Calm escalation leadership in user impacting cutover events.
  • Clear communicator: logs, evidence and precise guidance rather than guesswork.
  • Strong coaching and collaboration behaviours across shifts and teams.
  • Risk and dependency management mindset; prevents avoidable disruption.
  • High integrity around access/security and change discipline.
  • Strong written communication: tickets, handovers, playbooks.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Lower endpoint migration failure rate and improved first time success.
  • MTTR for endpoint migration blockers during cutovers.
  • Repeat issue reduction via improved runbooks and known fix catalogues.
  • Evidence completion rate for endpoint acceptance checks.
  • Readiness pass rate for endpoint components at wave entry.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

Scale teams operate as a cohesive unit within a follow the sun project delivery model. Each scale team works an 8 hour shift, scheduled across a 24 hour global working day. Structured handovers between scale teams are mandatory and cutover periods may require rota flexibility.

jobDescription:
The Role



Turium AI is seeking a senior, hands-on SAP S/4HANA Implementation Lead with extensive implementation and functional delivery experience.

This is not a purely advisory or architecture position. You will lead client workshops, provide functional leadership, configure SAP S/4HANA and work directly with delivery teams throughout the full implementation lifecycle from design and configuration through testing, go-live and hypercare.

As a senior functional representative of Turium AI, you will build client confidence in our SAP capability, solution design and delivery approach. You must be comfortable engaging with executives and senior stakeholders while remaining actively involved in configuration, documentation, testing, troubleshooting and issue resolution.

You will work closely with consultants and delivery teams across Australia and India, providing implementation leadership, mentoring team members and maintaining consistent delivery standards across SAP programs.



Key Responsibilities



  • Lead SAP S/4HANA functional design and implementation activities.
  • Lead functional workstreams from discovery and design through configuration, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
  • Facilitate fit-to-standard workshops with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Translate business requirements into practical SAP process designs, configuration and solution recommendations.
  • Perform hands-on SAP S/4HANA configuration within the relevant functional specialisation.
  • Configure and support end-to-end SAP business processes.
  • Promote SAP standard functionality and a clean-core, standard-first implementation approach.
  • Review proposed enhancements and customisations for business value, maintainability and alignment with SAP best practices.
  • Provide functional leadership to SAP consultants, developers, integration specialists, data teams and testers.
  • Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, process designs, test scenarios and supporting implementation documentation.
  • Support integration design between SAP S/4HANA and external enterprise systems.
  • Work closely with data migration, security, reporting, workflow and technical teams.
  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover planning and production deployment.
  • Investigate and resolve functional defects, configuration issues and process gaps.
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation, risk management and delivery governance.
  • Present solution recommendations, design decisions, risks and implementation options to client stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level consultants and contribute to the continued development of Turium AI s SAP implementation capability.
  • Coordinate distributed delivery teams across Australia and India to maintain implementation quality, accountability and successful project outcomes.
  • Represent Turium AI professionally and strengthen client confidence in our SAP delivery capability.



Required Experience



  • At least 5-10 years of SAP functional consulting experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and configuring SAP S/4HANA.
  • Current SAP S/4HANA certification relevant to the candidate s functional specialisation at Associate or Professional level.
  • Strong expertise in one or more SAP S/4HANA functional areas, including FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM, PM, QM or another relevant module.
  • Experience delivering at least two end-to-end SAP or SAP S/4HANA implementation programs.
  • Demonstrated experience leading functional workstreams, fit-to-standard workshops and solution design sessions.
  • Strong understanding of the SAP Activate methodology.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications, configuration documentation, process designs and test scenarios.
  • Experience supporting data migration, integrations, security, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Fiori applications, workflows, business roles and authorisations.
  • Ability to understand APIs, interfaces and technical integration concepts while operating as a functional delivery leader.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, presentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership and remain accountable for functional outcomes.
  • Experience leading SAP teams across multiple locations or offshore delivery models.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on throughout the implementation lifecycle.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who combines senior-level credibility with a practical, delivery-focused mindset.

You should be equally comfortable presenting to executives, facilitating business workshops, configuring SAP, reviewing functional designs, troubleshooting defects and supporting the delivery team through testing and go-live.

You will be expected to take ownership, make informed recommendations and lead successful SAP S/4HANA implementation workstreams while helping establish Turium AI as a highly capable SAP implementation partner across Australia and India.

title: Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to own the technical design and delivery of client-facing and internal modules across .NET, modern JavaScript frontends, and cloud. You will turn functional requirements into designs that are secure, scalable, and maintainable and then build a substantial part of them yourself.

This is a coding role first and a leadership role second. Expect to spend the majority of your time in the codebase: writing the hard parts, reviewing pull requests, unblocking your team, and holding the quality line. You will work closely with the Solution Architect and delivery leadership on the wider architecture, and you will be the person who makes sure it actually lands in production the way it was designed.

You will also be hands-on in how we adopt AI/ML and LLM-based capabilities across our delivery portfolio.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Design & Delivery

  • Own the technical design of assigned modules and applications application logic, integration points, data model, and deployment approach.
  • Translate functional requirements and user stories into technical designs, sequence diagrams, API contracts, and data models.
  • Contribute to solution-level architecture decisions and document trade-offs for the options considered and rejected.
  • Break down features into tasks, estimate effort realistically, and drive them to completion within sprint commitments.
  • Design with non-functional requirements in mind from the start: performance, scalability, security, observability, and cost.
  • Execute staged modernisation of legacy applications (e.g., .NET Framework / .NET Core current LTS) under an agreed migration plan.
  • Apply and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, branching strategy, code review expectations, test coverage, and definition of done.

Hands-On Engineering

  • Write production code for the complex, high-risk, or performance-critical parts of the system.
  • Build proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable components for the team.
  • Review pull requests with substance correctness, security, performance, and readability, not just style.
  • Diagnose production issues: performance bottlenecks, memory pressure, N+1 queries, cache behaviour, and concurrency problems.
  • Keep CI/CD, automated testing, and quality gates working and taken seriously by the team.

Cloud & Platform

  • Build and operate solutions on Azure or AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, and secrets management.
  • Implement containerisation and deployment pipelines where appropriate (Docker, and Kubernetes/AKS/EKS where in use).
  • Instrument applications for observability logging, metrics, tracing, alerting and act on what they show.
  • Flag cost implications of design choices and implement agreed optimisations.

AI/ML & LLM Solutions

  • Build LLM-backed features: RAG pipelines, chunking and embedding strategy, vector store integration, retrieval quality, and prompt and context design.
  • Understand the practical trade-offs between prompt engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning, and pick sensibly for the problem at hand.
  • Handle the real constraints of LLM systems: latency, token cost, rate limits, caching, fallback behaviour, and graceful degradation.
  • Implement evaluation and guardrails groundedness checks, hallucination mitigation, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Have an informed view on where AI/ML genuinely adds value and where it does not.
  • Work with data engineering on the pipelines and data quality these features depend on.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Lead a team of 38 engineers day to day: task allocation, standups, unblocking, and progress visibility.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
  • Own the technical quality of what your team ships, including defect triage and release readiness.
  • Support technical hiring interviewing and candidate evaluation.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, tech talks, and reusable IP.

Client & Delivery Support

  • Join technical discussions and requirement clarification sessions with clients where needed.
  • Provide effort estimates and technical inputs for proposals and solution approach documents.
  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to project managers, clients, and stakeholders.

Required Skills


Must Have Depth Expected

  • 69 years in software engineering, with production systems you have personally built and shipped.
  • Strong .NET / C# ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, async programming, dependency injection, and current LTS versions.
  • Solid working experience with one cloud platform Azure or AWS. Azure preferred (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID, Application Insights). AWS equivalents equally acceptable.
  • At least one modern frontend framework in depth Angular or React plus TypeScript. Working familiarity with the other is a plus.
  • Node.js for services, tooling, or BFF layers.
  • Databases: strong SQL (SQL Server / PostgreSQL), data modelling, indexing, and query tuning. Awareness of NoSQL and when it fits.
  • Design and architectural patterns: REST API design, layered/clean architecture, messaging and queues, caching strategies, and a working understanding of microservices and event-driven design including when a monolith is the better answer.
  • Security fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, RBAC, secrets management, OWASP Top 10.
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git branching strategies, Docker.

Must Have Working Understanding

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts and the ML lifecycle.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM-based application development RAG, embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or similar), and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with major model providers and the trade-offs between hosted APIs and self-hosted/open models.
  • Python for AI/ML, scripting, and data work.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform).

Non-Technical

  • Clear written communication your design notes and PR comments matter as much as your code.
  • Ability to explain a technical trade-off to a project manager and to a junior engineer, on the same day, without changing your answer.
  • Comfortable being challenged and equally comfortable changing your mind when the argument is better.
  • Ownership: you follow a decision through to production, not to the end of the design phase.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's is a plus.
  • Equivalent demonstrable experience will be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Preferred (Added Advantage)

  • Cloud certification Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or the AWS equivalents.
  • Experience in an IT services or consulting environment with multiple concurrent clients.
  • Exposure to data engineering and analytics Azure Synapse, Databricks, PySpark, dbt, Power BI.
  • Experience running containerised workloads in production.
  • Experience shipping an AI/LLM feature to production, including how it was evaluated.
  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking.

What Success Looks Like in This Role


First 90 days

  • Productive in the codebase and reviewing pull requests independently.
  • Understood the module landscape you own and identified its top technical risks with evidence.
  • Delivered at least one design document and one feature shipped end to end.

First 6–12 months

  • Engineering standards consistently followed by your team, with review and test discipline visibly improved.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery predictability, defect escape rate, or system performance.
  • At least one AI/LLM capability built, evaluated, and delivered to production or a credible pilot.
  • One or more engineers visibly levelled up under your mentorship.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of the technical design and delivery of the systems you work on.
  • Direct access to leadership and a short path from decision to implementation.
  • Room to grow into a Solution Architect role, with the support to get there.
  • Hands-on work on modern cloud and AI engineering, not maintenance.
  • Sponsorship for certifications and continuous learning.
  • A collaborative, engineering-led environment.

How to Apply

Share your CV at [careers email] with the subject line "Application – Technical Lead – Pune". Include a brief note on one technical decision you made that turned out to be wrong, and what you did about it.

We enable financial institutions to become digital leaders.

We welcome candidates who share our values, have the skills and are passionate to enjoy our journey to build the AI-first future of finance, together.


About the Role

This is a senior engineering position within VeriPark's AI Engineering practice, embedded in our R&D and product delivery teams. You will design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI solutions that power the next generation of banking and financial services applications.

VeriPark is a Microsoft strategic partner exclusively focused on the financial services industry. Our products -- VeriChannel, VeriTouch, VeriBranch, VeriLoan, and VeriLink -- serve over 150 banks in 30+ countries. You will operate at the frontier of Microsoft's AI platform, deploying intelligent agents, conversational AI, and automation workflows that make our clients AI-first digital leaders.

The primary engineering language for this role is C#. You will be expected to build production AI applications on the Microsoft Azure stack, with Microsoft AI Foundry and Microsoft Copilot Studio as your core platforms. Beyond delivery, you will play an active role in PoC initiatives, technical pre-sales, and evaluating emerging AI technologies -- bridging R&D and client-facing work.


What You Will Be Doing

AI Agent & Solution Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions using Microsoft AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Agent Framework and popular OSS stack -- from proof-of-concept through to production.
  • Develop C# / .NET applications that orchestrate multi-agent workflows for banking use cases such as relationship manager intelligence, loan servicing automation, and conversational banking.
  • Build and extend custom Copilot Studio agents: authoring topics, configuring connectors and plugins, integrating with enterprise data sources, and maintaining conversation quality.
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Azure AI Search, vector stores, and Azure OpenAI Service for grounded, citation-backed responses.
  • Participate in the design, development, and deployment of LLM-based solutions including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and domain adaptation techniques.

Integration & Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement backend services and APIs in C# / .NET that connect AI capabilities to core banking systems, CRM (Dynamics 365), and data platforms.
  • Contribute to the packaging, deployment, and lifecycle management of AI agents via Microsoft AI Foundry, ensuring reusability and enterprise-readiness.
  • Build robust, observable AI pipelines with Azure Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and structured logging.

Innovation & Technology Evaluation

  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies and open-source tools -- including new agent frameworks, vector search solutions, and foundation models -- into VeriPark's product suite.
  • Take an active role in Proof-of-Concept (PoC) initiatives: preparing demo environments, prototypes, and solution proposals aligned with client needs and VeriPark's product roadmap.
  • Collaborate with sales and business development teams by providing technical expertise during client engagements, supporting proposal preparation, solution demos, and responding to RFPs/RFIs with AI capability insights.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work closely with VeriPark's product managers, business analysts, and solution architects to translate banking requirements into AI-powered features.
  • Contribute to VeriPark's AI engineering standards, reusable patterns, and internal knowledge base.
  • Provide technical guidance, architecture documentation, and mentoring to junior engineers in the team.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML or agentic AI solutions.
  • Strong C# and .NET development background -- this is the primary language requirement; the majority of your delivery will be in C#.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft AI Foundry: model catalog, prompt flow, evaluations, deployments, and responsible AI tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Agent Framework (the evolution of Semantic Kernel) for building production-grade agentic systems in .NET: multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling, process automation, and agent lifecycle management. Familiarity with Semantic Kernel as the established foundation and with the M365 Agents SDK for building agents that integrate natively with Microsoft 365 experiences.
  • Proven experience with Azure OpenAI Service: prompt engineering, chat completions, structured outputs, function-calling, and RAG patterns.
  • Experience with Azure AI Search: vector indexing, hybrid retrieval, semantic ranking, and indexer pipelines.
  • Understanding of multi-agent architectures: agent orchestration, handoff protocols, tool-use patterns, and guardrail design.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field -- or equivalent hands-on experience.

Preferred Qualifications

These are not mandatory at the start, but they significantly strengthen a candidacy:

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio: building agents, authoring topics, configuring connectors, integrating APIs and enterprise data sources.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform, and enterprise process automation integrated with AI agents.
  • Familiarity with Azure platform services: Azure Functions, Azure App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Service Bus.
  • Python experience and familiarity with OSS AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen and others) -- treated as a strong plus, not a requirement. Awareness of the broader open-source agent ecosystem is valued.
  • Domain experience in financial services or banking -- understanding of core banking workflows, compliance requirements, or regulated environments.
  • Microsoft certifications: AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate), AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate), or DP-600 preferred. Willingness to obtain AI-102 within the first year of joining is expected.
  • Experience with Azure Machine Learning for model fine-tuning, custom model evaluation, and MLflow-based experiment tracking.

What We Are Offering

  • Remote Freedom, Your Way: At VeriPark we believe in the power of talent, no matter where it resides. Design your ideal workspace and achieve the perfect work-life balance.
  • Performance-Linked Bonus: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Enjoy a performance-linked bonus as a recognition of your impact and dedication.
  • Rewards Beyond the Job: Comprehensive benefits including Remote Work Support, Health Insurance, Care Program, and Online Psychological Support.
  • Birthday Leave, Because You Matter: Take the day off on your birthday and treat yourself.
  • Global Impact, Cutting-Edge Technology: Work on meaningful AI projects with leading financial institutions globally and stay ahead with the latest Microsoft AI platform releases.
  • Unleash Your Potential: Develop yourself through VeriPark Academy, Microsoft certification support, webinars, and in-house training sessions.
  • Diverse, Vibrant Community: Be part of a dynamic, inclusive environment that values different perspectives and experiences.
  • Together Culture: Even in a remote-first world, we cultivate connections through face-to-face gatherings and online events that keep the team close.

About VeriPark

VeriPark is a global technology company with more than 25 years of expertise in the financial services industry. Our mission is to enable banks and financial institutions to become AI-first digital leaders by delivering world-class customer journeys across digital and assisted channels.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Job Description Transformation Architect AI / Automation (Senior Manager)

Function: Clients & Industries, EY Global Delivery Services India LLP

As part of EY s GMx (Global Managed Services Transformation) initiative, we are re imagining how next-generation managed service transformations are designed and delivered leveraging modern AI, machine learning, deep learning, automation, cloud-native engineering, and intelligent operations to build future-ready, insight-driven service delivery models.

The Opportunity

As part of EY s GMx (Global Managed Services Transformation) initiative, this role leads AI driven transformation/ modernization across Managed Services. You will lead, program manage, architect, and deliver next generation solutions using modern AI (Gen AI, Agentic AI) , machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, automation, with cloud native engineering to transform managed service operations into scalable, cost effective, value driven, insight led, AI enabled service models. This role enables EY to accelerate value, enhance operational outcomes, and build the future ready Managed Services operations.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Program manage and architect AI driven transformation initiatives for Managed Services.
  • Hold customer discussions to enable the customer with required information and give direction the program.
  • Act as TPM for the AI led managed service transformation programs - taking value driven tech decisions.
  • Lead end to end delivery of AI modernization programs (design build deploy ship).
  • Deliver AI/ML-driven transformation across multi year managed services engagements.
  • Lead and mentor cross-functional teams (AI engineers, ML engineers, automation developers, data engineers, cloud specialists).
  • Define governance, delivery frameworks, KPIs, quality standards, and operational oversight.
  • Translate client needs into AI/automation/data use cases, backlogs, and solution roadmaps.
  • Identify modernization opportunities using analytics, automation discovery, and process re-engineering.
  • Drive continuous improvement using AIOps, observability, predictive insights, and automation-first processes.
  • Ensure security, compliance, data protection, and operational stability across all AI and data platforms.

Technical Expertise Requirements

Use Cases & Architecture (Must)

  • Ability to quickly understand new business processes and identify high ROI AI/ML transformation opportunities.
  • Hands-on experience in architecting (technical + solution architecture) AI/ML-driven transformation assets and platforms.
  • Expertise in embedding security, responsible/ethical AI, and data governance into AI architectures while ensuring clear RoI and value realization.

Modern AI & Agentic AI (Must)

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI systems deployed in production on cloud using cloud native capabilities.
  • Expertise in multi-agent orchestration, tool-use agents, workflow agents, and enterprise-safe agentic architectures.
  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and AI orchestration frameworks.

Machine Learning & Deep Learning (Must)

  • Strong grounding in supervised/unsupervised ML, tree-based models, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
  • Experience with CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers, and generative models.
  • Proficiency in sklearn, MLlib, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Ability to build, optimize, validate, and deploy ML/DL models at enterprise scale.

MLOps & AI Platform Engineering (Must)

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD for ML, model registries, feature stores, drift detection, and model monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Databricks, AWS Sagemaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.

Cloud-Native AI Engineering (Must)

  • Ability to build, deploy, and operate containerized, microservices based AI workloads on Azure/AWS/GCP using Docker, Kubernetes, AKS/EKS/GKE.
  • Experience with serverless AI, event-driven architectures, GPU optimization, and scalable inference patterns.
  • Data Engineering (Desirable)
  • Familiarity with lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming pipelines, and real-time analytics.
  • Experience with Databricks, Spark, and cloud-native data engineering services.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

  • Ability to manage multiple Transformation programs simultaneously.
  • 12 16 years of experience in AI-driven technology delivery; 4 8+ years in AI/ML leadership roles.
  • Deep expertise in modern AI, ML/DL, MLOps, automation, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Strong Python development background.
  • Experience building, deploying, and shipping large-scale AI products in cloud-native production environments.
  • Experience identifying high-value AI use cases through data-driven value quantification.
  • Proven track record delivering complex AI-driven transformation programs.
  • Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
  • Preferred certifications: Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), AI/ML, Technical Architecture for AI/ML.

Skills and Attributes for Success

  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • Quality-oriented and detail-focused mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and manage complex multi-disciplinary programs.
  • Effective leadership and mentoring skills across global teams.

Core Capabilities

  • Methodical and structured thinking.
  • Strong analytical and reasoning abilities.
  • Effective communication and executive presence.
  • Results-driven and quality-focused delivery mindset.

Functional Capabilities

  • Ability to operate in dynamic, cross-functional, global environments.
  • Strong team collaboration and ability to manage ambiguity.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and outcome-oriented.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking abilities.

Additionally, you'll Also Have

  • Creative problem-solving capability.
  • Self-driven attitude and strong ownership.
  • Logical reasoning and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work across cultures and global teams.
  • Strong networking and cross-team collaboration.
  • Ability to build trust, strengthen team cohesion, and celebrate success.

What We Look For

  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Strong grounding in MLOps, AIOps, automation, and observability.
  • Experience supporting transformation in Managed Services environments.
  • Strong communication, planning, and stakeholder alignment skills.

What We Offer

  • Continuous learning: Develop future-ready AI, automation, and cloud capabilities.
  • Transformative leadership: Coaching and experiences to help you grow as a leader.
  • Diverse and inclusive culture: A place where youre empowered to bring your authentic self.

EY | Building a better working world



EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.



Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.



Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
